doc.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Night in Tunisia and the missed four-bar break
summary: Sitting in, Butch took a two-bar break instead of four and came in early, a mistake he never forgot.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Oh come on, you can tell us.

Well there was the time I sat in with a band and they said, “We’re going to play ‘Night in Tunisia.’” And I said, “Okay, great” not knowing about the four bar break after the insert before each solo starts. I had only been taught about two bar breaks. So we get to the end of it and I take a two bar break and come in on measure three big as life, while the soloist
is still setting up his entrance. And to this day I have never forgotten it. I made a big mistake and I learned from it. Ah, there’s a secret.
